name: food-delivery-monorepo
description: Monorepo for food delivery application with microfrontends

scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared-config && npm run build:host && npm run build:catalog-mfe && npm run build:cabinet-mfe
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=catalog-service" "npm run dev --workspace=cabinet-service"
